title.en: Send Country and Purchase Timing, Not a Request for Printed Lead Time
title.zh: 发送国家和采购时间，而不是索取已印交期

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai asks buyers to send country and purchase timing. The site does not print a fixed number of production days. Custom work also has no published day count.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台要求买家发送国家和采购时间。网站不印固定生产天数。定制同样没有公布天数。

h1.en: Purchase Timing Is Your Date, Not a Factory Day Count
h1.zh: 采购时间是你的日期，不是工厂天数

directAnswer.en: On a Hebei Pinjin Machinery inquiry from Xingtai, country and purchase timing are facts you supply. They are not a catalogue promise of how many days production takes. The custom-machinery wording says production can be arranged after a listed model is confirmed, and that this site does not publish a fixed number of production days. Write your target timing in ordinary language and ask the contact page to confirm what the factory can say.
directAnswer.zh: 向河北品锦机械（邢台）询盘时，国家和采购时间是你提供的事实。它们不是目录对生产多少天的承诺。定制机械的口径是：对照已列机型确认后可以安排生产，并且本站不公布固定生产天数。用普通说法写下你的目标时间，并请询盘页确认工厂能回复什么。

heading.en: What to write in the timing line

body.en: Write the month or season you hope to purchase, and the destination country. Do not write “standard 15 days” or any other day count. No such count is printed.
body.zh: 写下你希望采购的月份或季节，以及目的国家。不要写“标准 15 天”或任何其他天数。没有印过这种天数。

body.en: Timing does not replace the path, stone size, output or distances. A note that contains only a country cannot be matched to Electric 20 or Diesel 120.
body.zh: 时间不能代替路径、石子粒径、输送量或距离。只有国家的一封信，对不上电动20或柴油120。

body.en: [/en/contact/](/en/contact/), email PinjinHebei@Outlook.com, phone 19912003025, or the on-site WhatsApp button. Hebei Pinjin Machinery ships from Xingtai and does not list an overseas warehouse.
body.zh: 发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)、邮箱 PinjinHebei@Outlook.com、电话 19912003025 或站内 WhatsApp。河北品锦机械从邢台发货，不列海外仓。

question.en: Can you publish a production week?
question.zh: 能公布一个生产周数吗？

answer.en: No. That figure is not on the site.
answer.zh: 不能。网站上没有这个数字。

answer.en: No. Price is also unprinted and confirmed by inquiry.
answer.zh: 不是。价格同样未印，由询盘确认。

question.en: Does custom work have a printed schedule?

answer.en: No fixed number of production days is published.
answer.zh: 没有公布固定生产天数。

question.en: Which country list should I pick from?
question.zh: 我该从哪份国家名单里选？

answer.en: There is no export-country list. Write the country you are buying for.
answer.zh: 没有出口国名单。写下你采购所对应的国家。
